description: Protects repository routing for test strategy, eligible test-file documentation, browser fixtures, validation and database overlaps, semantic-substitution regressions, and near misses.

cases.title: Plan responsive QA for database-backed learner states

executor_input.prompt: Identify every applicable repo-local skill before planning the responsive browser QA and state the evidence gate.

context.content: Browser or manual QA is planned. It has not been run. Remote database permission is absent.

criteria.description: The response routes frontend-design, frontend-workflow, and test-quality-strategy and requires reproducible authenticated states before browser observation.

expected_behavior: A migrated test-quality-strategy candidate selects references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md and references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md and skips references/test-plan-headers.md and references/mocking-and-regression.md. Physical reference expectations remain limited to the evaluated TQS bundle; routed frontend skills create no cross-bundle physical obligation. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.
forbidden_behavior: Omit the test owner, treat design as the fixture owner, or claim browser completion before fixture readiness and observation.

safety_vetoes.description: The route set omits an owning skill required for truthful browser and fixture planning.

cases.title: Add denied RLS and concurrent payment coverage

executor_input.prompt: Identify every applicable repo-local skill before adding the denied-path and concurrency integration coverage.

context.content: The task creates, changes, or reviews a non-trivial integration, API, form-interaction, multi-branch Server Action, important-regression, concurrency, RLS, or multi-group test file.

criteria.description: The response routes supabase-safe-migration, test-quality-strategy, and code-commenting-and-maintainability, excludes nextjs-server-action-zod without an app boundary, and requires real integration coverage.

expected_behavior: A migrated test-quality-strategy candidate selects references/test-plan-headers.md and skips references/smoke-e2e-and-browser.md, references/manual-qa-and-fixtures.md, and references/mocking-and-regression.md. Physical reference expectations remain limited to the TQS bundle; no SSM or commenting reference is imposed by this execution. The unsplit baseline has no future-reference obligation.

safety_vetoes.description: The response omits supabase-safe-migration or test-quality-strategy for the real database invariant.

executor_input.prompt: Identify the applicable repo-local skill and conditional procedure before designing regression protection for the supplied cross-artifact relationship defect. This task selects the strategy only; it does not create, change, or review a concrete test file.

context.content: Each object is individually schema-valid, but an accepted result can currently link one valid decision to evidence authorized by another decision. The regression must isolate the semantic relationship rather than malformed input.

criteria.description: The response routes test-quality-strategy and selects its mocking/regression procedure because the regression substitutes an individually valid object across a semantic relationship.

expected_behavior: Select references/mocking-and-regression.md, begin from a valid positive graph, and change one semantic dimension at a time while preserving schema validity and unrelated fields. Skip the browser, fixture, and test-plan-header procedures.
forbidden_behavior: Treat schema validity as sufficient, fuzz malformed objects instead of the relationship, or read unrelated conditional procedures.
